versions.changelog:
clawface 0.0.3

- Version updated to 0.0.3.
- Documentation refreshed in SKILL.md; no functional changes noted.

- Added a new Security section to the documentation, clarifying that credentials never reach the browser and explaining upstream authentication.
- Updated usage instructions to emphasize the handling of gateway tokens and identity files.
- Bumped version to 0.0.2.

Initial release of Clawface: a 3D avatar chat web UI with built-in TTS.

- Serves a local web page for users to interact with a 3D avatar and chat interface.
- Requires Node.js; runs on macOS and Linux.
- Automates downloading sherpa-onnx TTS runtime and Lessac English voice model.
- No browser automation—prints the URL, user opens in their browser.
- Zero external dependencies; no npm install required.
- Self-contained server handles TTS internally.
